newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo prosecutors raid Nomura HQ - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo prosecutors raid Nomura HQ - Jiji.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors on Thursday raided the headquarters of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Jiji news agency reported.
Earlier in the day, prosecutors charged former Nomura president Hideo Sakamaki with making illegal payoffs to corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike.

They also served Sakamaki and two other former Nomura executives with new arrest warrants alleging they conspired to pay Koike 320 million yen in cash around March 24, 1995, in exchange for a pledge by him to ensure that the firm's June shareholders' meeting went smoothly.
But a Nomura spokesman later denied the Jiji report.
"There has been no raid at our headquarters today," said a Nomura Securities spokesman. "There was no such investigation."
